_meta.description: Canonical BG3 game data for bg3-to-5e converter. All UUID mappings, spell lists, class features, race data, equipment, and filter lists.

Strongheart Halfling.notes: BG3's Strongheart is similar to 5e's Stout Halfling

Wildheart.notes: BG3's Wildheart combines aspects of Totem Warrior

mechanic_differences: BG3: Choose maneuver before attack. 5e: Choose on hit
BG3: Choose maneuver before attack. 5e: Choose on hit

Barbarian: BG3: Rage bonus applies to DEX-based melee attacks. 5e: STR only.
Battle Master: BG3: Choose maneuver before making attack roll.
5e: Can choose maneuver after hitting (before damage).
Paladin: BG3: Divine Smite is a bonus action.
5e: Divine Smite is decided after hitting (not an action).
Warlock: BG3: Eldritch Blast is always learned.
5e: Must choose Eldritch Blast as a cantrip.

mechanic_differences: BG3: Can throw as bonus action. 5e: Action to throw.
BG3: Extra action can be used for any action.
5e: Extra action limited to Attack (one weapon attack only), Dash, Disengage, Hide, or Use an Object.
BG3: Causes Frightened condition.
5e: Causes 3d6 psychic damage and target must flee (no Frightened).
BG3: Duration is based on turns/rounds.
5e: Duration is up to 1 hour (concentration).
BG3: Save at end of each turn.
5e: Save at end of each turn (same, but duration differences in video game context).
BG3: Each missile rolls damage separately.
5e: Roll once, apply to all missiles (RAW, though many tables roll separately).
BG3: Uses HP threshold per creature.
5e: Roll 5d8, affect creatures in ascending HP order until pool exhausted.

Fireball.notes: Damage and radius are the same, but BG3 has more precise area targeting.

mechanic_differences: BG3: Warlocks always learn this cantrip.
5e: Must be chosen as one of your cantrips known.
BG3: Reaction is automatic when enemy casts.
5e: Must identify the spell being cast (optional rule) and choose to react.
BG3: Extra damage is 1d6 regardless of weapon.
5e: Same damage, but concentration and transfer rules may differ in implementation.

Hex.notes: Mechanically similar, but BG3 handles ability check disadvantage differently in dialogue.

Misty Step.notes: Functions identically, though BG3 has more precise positioning.

Black Hole.notes: BG3-only Illithid power. Consider as homebrew.

Mourning Frost.notes: BG3-unique staff. Consider as Staff of Frost or homebrew.

Spear of Night.notes: BG3-unique. Shar's artifact. Treat as homebrew legendary.

Sword of Justice.notes: BG3-unique. Treat as +1 Greatsword with Tyr's Protection.

Grymskull Helm.notes: BG3-unique. Fire immunity. Treat as homebrew.

Helldusk Armour.notes: BG3-unique. Treat as legendary plate armor with fire resistance.

Balduran's Giantslayer.notes: BG3-unique. Consider as Giant Slayer greatsword.

Markoheshkir.notes: BG3-unique legendary staff. Consider as Staff of the Magi or homebrew.

Bloodthirst.notes: BG3-unique dagger. Treat as homebrew legendary.

Nyrulna.notes: BG3-unique trident. Treat as homebrew legendary.
